runtimeArchitectureFinding.masonryWinit: NOT runnable on web: event_loop_runner.rs:965 pollster::block_on(render_cx.create_surface(...)) synchronously blocks on JS-async WebGPU adapter/device futures — compiles but can never resolve in a browser
runtimeArchitectureFinding.pocPath: Bypass masonry_winit entirely: drive masonry_core::RenderRoot directly — handle_pointer_event() in, redraw() -> (vello Scene, Option<accesskit TreeUpdate>) out, we own WebGPU device + vello Renderer::render_to_texture + wgpu TextureBlitter -> canvas surface. This IS the V12 §8.2 CanvasWidgetIsland shape (no winit window, scene fragment composited into our canvas)
